Property: Unit 804, Marina Heights Tower, Dubai Marina, Dubai, UAE
Term of Lease: February 1, 2024 to January 31, 2025 (fixed 12-month term, renewable with mutual agreement)
Payment Due: On or before the 1st of each month
Security Deposit: AED 6,500 held by the Landlord as security for damages or unpaid rent, refundable within 30 days after the end of the lease, minus deductions for damages
Utilities: Tenant is responsible for DEWA (electricity & water), Internet, Gas (if applicable). Landlord is responsible for building service charges, maintenance of major systems (AC, plumbing, electrical)
Late Fees: AED 150 if rent is not paid within 5 days of the due date
Use of Property: Property is for residential use only. No subletting without written permission. Tenant must keep the property clean and in good condition
Early Termination: Either party may terminate early with 60 days’ written notice. Tenant remains responsible for rent during the notice period
Entry by Landlord: Landlord may enter the property with 24 hours’ notice for inspections or repairs, except in emergencies
